name: @study/desktop
description: 틈틈이 한 문제씩 푸는 직장인 공부 앱
author: Study Alarm

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-app-config.mjs && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && node scripts/run-packaged.mjs
scripts.dev:electron-raw: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/patch-electron-mac-icon.mjs && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron .
scripts.dev:nowait: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-app-config.mjs && node scripts/run-packaged.mjs
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p native && swiftc -emit-library -o native/libstudy_notif.dylib scripts/study_notif_auth.swift -framework UserNotifications -framework Foundation
scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/write-app-config.mjs
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml
